name: weather
desc: Weather bubble state. The phone pushes temp/code via AppMessage (see widget.js); the watch persists, formats, and dirties on change only. No on-watch timers or polling.

clay.label: Show Weather
clay.description: Turn off to hide the temperature bubble and stop background weather updates.

clay.label: Temperature Units
clay.description: Choose how the weather bubble displays temperature.

cost.wakeups: none on-watch; phone fetches hourly with a 30min location cache (see widget_weather.js)
cost.redraws: background on code change, weather text on temp/units change; unchanged values never redraw
cost.persist: temp/code/units/enabled, each written solely on change
cost.notes: Visibility itself is evaluated by generated draw/visible helpers; the widget only feeds state.
